description: A dozen crates facing a slate, and on the wall above the slate a clock with the case off, so the escapement is out in the open and the whole class can watch it let go, and let go, and let go. The slate this morning carries long division, a diagram of a lever with the fulcrum in the wrong place and a correction beside it in a smaller hand, and, low down where a short person could reach, somebody's name written out thirty times, getting better.
name: The Schoolroom
